methodology.order: 12 cases then reverse order, sequential separate processes
methodology.full_path: event polling, normal Surface lifecycle, input, collision hooks, view work, GL capture/replay when enabled, postprocessing, swap, housekeeping, glFinish
methodology.cpu_time: process_time_ns around Surface.frame plus glFinish; process CPU, not exclusive render-thread time
methodology.workload: same make_views collection/widget bodies, 25/100/300 rows; viewport-bounded root collection, all bodies execute on a full redraw
methodology.hot: unchanged inputs; cache-off still executes every body
methodology.redraw: mutate Row 0000 count and explicitly invalidate the entire cache when enabled
methodology.row: mutate Row 0000 count and invalidate that row by object reference
methodology.profiles: separate diagnostic runs, not used for primary timing ratios; cProfile inflates Python time
